points: Your site shows 1,00,000+ families and 366 reviews, yet none of your 24 ads use either number. Cold buyers get no proof before the click. Put the review count on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.
Your site offers 20% off, yet only 4 of 23 ads mention a percentage discount. Buyers see no price reason to act today. Put the offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

17 of 23 copy ads open on the same line about kids and parents, which repeats one message. Name two or three new angles from your product, like ISI certified safety, washable fabric and Diwali hampers, and run them against it.
The same copy runs in 13 of 23 ads, so buyers see an identical message again and again. Keep the body copy, but change the opening line and the creative in each of the 13 ads.
